course.title: MBChB Medicine (2027 entry) | The University of Manchester
quotes: Duration: 5 years Year of entry: 2027 UCAS course code: A106 / Institution code: M20
Typical A-level offer : AAA (including specific subjects)
Biology/Human Biology or Chemistry; and One of the following subjects from Chemistry; Biology/Human Biology; Physics; Psychology; Mathematics or Further Mathematics.
36 points overall. 6,6,6, in Higher Level subjects.
Major subjects must include Chemistry or Biology, plus another science (one from Chemistry, Biology, Physics, Psychology or Mathematics) and one further subject at Higher Level.
International English Language Testing Service (IELTS): A minimum average score of 7.0 and with not less than 6.5 in any one component taken at the same sitting;
All applicants, including dental applicants, must sit the UCAT
We do not make any offers without interview.
Tuition fees for home students commencing their studies in September 2026 will be £9,535 for the 2026/27 academic year.
Tuition fees for international students on the Pre-Clinical part of the programme (Years 1-2) will be £39,900 for the 2026/2027 academic year.

Fees for the Clinical part of the programme (Years 3-5) are set at the rate applicable when entering Year 3. For students entering the Clinical part of the programme in 2026, the fee for 2026/27 will be £60,900.
the University reserves the right to increase the tuition fee by up to 7% each year

costs.note: Home fee published on the 2027-entry page: £9,535 for the 2026/27 academic year (students starting September 2026).

Latest published international fees (2026/27): £39,900 a year in pre-clinical Years 1-2 and £60,900 a year in clinical Years 3-5. Shown as the average over 5 years: £52,500 a year. Clinical fees are set at the rate when you enter Year 3, and the University may raise fees by up to 7% each year, so later entrants are likely to pay more.
